name: POCAHONTAS
description: This musical tells the story of Pocahontas, an indigenous girl from the Powhatan tribe, and her encounter with English colonists. It explores themes of friendship, love, and racial prejudice between two different peoples.
longDescription:
The musical "POCAHONTAS" is presented at Super Bock Arena in Porto. The performance is scheduled for December 12, 2026, starting at 11:30. Doors open at 14:30, and there is no intermission.

The story follows Pocahontas, a kind yet independent girl from the Powhatan tribe, during a time of conflict with English colonists. When colonists are captured and sentenced to death, Pocahontas intervenes, leading to a friendship with John Smith and a subsequent love story that confronts racial prejudice.

Ticket prices range from €18 for Plateia Lateral to €20 for Plateia Central. The show is suitable for ages 6 and up, with entry permitted for children aged 3 and above. The production is by Yellow Star Company, with artistic direction by Paulo Sousa Costa and João Didelet as director.
descriptionPt: Este musical conta a história de Pocahontas, uma rapariga indígena da tribo Powhatan, e o seu encontro com colonos ingleses. Explora temas de amizade, amor e preconceito racial entre dois povos diferentes.
